subject: A UK retro-game retailer for BuyHub — free researched example
html:
Hi BuyHub team,

I prepared a UK retro-game retailer example for BuyHub: Hidden Chest Gaming / RetroGear. Its console specialist, Ant Harper, has a published business email, and the linked RetroGear service explicitly buys old consoles, computers and whole collections.

The attached profile includes the current contact, original buying sources and a suggested conversation about a saved-search trial for one hardware family, keeping region, condition and delivered cost visible.

I also have five additional distinct UK retailers prepared to the same depth for US$20 total, including editable CSV and complete source links. One correction or replacement within seven days covers an existing customer, duplicate, dead published contact or clear mismatch.

Would you like the five-profile pack?

Bryce
Token Junkie Labs
